s001 τοσούτῳ → 'by so much' headed on 'much' is right under rule 104's degree-correlative clause (τοσοῦτος is the demonstrative member of the ἡλίκος/πηλίκος paradigm, which heads on the dimension word), with the dative of measure's 'by' riding along under rule 21.

s004 τῶν → 'than the' headed on 'the' follows rule 21: the genitive of comparison is what 'than' realizes, and it rides with the article that carries the English determiner. Giving 'than' to κρείττων instead remains defensible, but the expressed παρά at s008 taking its own 'than' shows the ASV writes the comparison word for whatever realizes the compared term, so the rule 21 reading is the consistent one and the unit's note already names the choice.

The prior review line on the file records this same correction and it has been applied.
